title: Py4JJavaError: Using Pyspark in Jupyter notebook trying to run examples using "spark."
question:
I'm trying to run the examples (for example spark/examples/src/main/python/ml/fpgrowth_example.py) for PySpark in Jupyter notebook. However, I am getting exceptions any time I try to do "spark.(some function)" In the case of this example, it is spark.createDataFrame, but I have also tried spark.read and it resulted in the same exception. I have also tried creating my own sparkSession, and using the one that is already in Jupyter notebook on start, and neither worked correctly. The main excpetion I can find is AnalysisException: 'java.lang.RuntimeException: java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to instantiate org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.metadata.SessionHiveMetaStoreClient;'

answer:
I'm not sure the problem what I was facing before is related to this issue. But anyway it's related to hadoop issue on Windows operating system. We should manually install Hadoop on Windows.

Please follow below steps:

1. Download Hadoop 3.3.4 for Windows

  • Go to: https://github.com/cdarlint/winutils

  • Navigate to `hadoop-3.3.6/bin/`

  • Download all files, especially `winutils.exe` and `hadoop.dll`
    2. Install Hadoop

  • Create Hadoop Directory

  • Copy Hadoop Files

    • Copy all downloaded files to `C:\hadoop\bin\`
    • Ensure `winutils.exe` and `hadoop.dll` are in `C:\hadoop\bin\`

  • Set Permissions (Important!)


   C:\hadoop\bin\winutils.exe chmod 777 C:\hadoop\bin

3. Install JavaSDK
4. Set Env Variable and Path
Set the path of JDK and Hadoop in system environment variables

Variable:
Variable Name: JAVA_HOME
Variable Value: C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-11.0.x (or your Java installation path)

Path:
C:\hadoop\bin
%JAVA_HOME%\bin

If you set this, you can download spark jar files and can store dataframes on your local spark folder.
And please note that use python version 3.11 not 3.12.
3.12 recognize some warnings as error while 3.11 don't.
